answer_1.quote: the aim is to produce a proper response Y = u_m for completion of the goal

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation ... we follow the setting in previous work to use several common metrics such as F1, BLEU (BLEU1 and BLEU2), and DISTINCT (DIST-1 and DIST-2) ... knowledge precision/recall/F1 scores ... dialog-Leading Success rate (LS) ... User-Topic Consistency rate (UTC)

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation is conducted at the level of both turns and dialogs ... evaluated by three persons in terms of fluency, appropriateness, informativeness, proactivity, and knowledge accuracy ... evaluated by three persons in terms of two metrics: (1) coherence ... and (2) recommendation success rate
answer_4.guideline: Scoring criteria are defined for each metric (e.g., fluency: score 0 for unfluent, score 1 for some errors, score 2 for fluent; coherence: score 0 for poor, score 2 for good)
